details.Call_Script: Hi SHAHRZAD JAMEA, Omar with TranchAI. Calling directly regarding A DENTAL GROUP's active operations in HOUSTON—saw you're expanding and wanted to ask: who currently handles your after-hours and overflow call intake?
details.First_Question: How is your front desk currently finding time to call through overdue 6-month hygiene recall lists?

What happens when front desk staff are checking in patients and both phone lines ring at once?
How many unscheduled treatment plans from last month have not had a direct phone follow-up?
details.Quantification_Question: If you have 400 dormant patients overdue for hygiene, that is $80,000 in uncollected chair production. How much of that did you recover last month?
details.Reflection_Script: So if I understand correctly, the issue isn't lead volume — it's that high-value opportunities slip through when your team is occupied. Is that fair?
details.AI_Fit_Transition: That's exactly why we built the AI Front-Desk Overflow & Hygiene Recall Recovery Agent. It integrates with your current schedule, answers on the 1st ring, qualifies the job specifications, and books the appointment directly.
details.CTA_Primary: Let's do a 15-minute diagnostic on Google Meet this Thursday at 10 AM to test the live voice agent against your current workflow. Does that time work for you?
details.CTA_Fallback: No problem at all SHAHRZAD JAMEA. What's the best email address to send our 1-page operational benchmark report to?

Objection_Playbook.NO_NEED: Understood. If you ever experience missed calls during peak season, keep us in mind.
Objection_Playbook.NO_BUDGET: If budget is tight, that's even more reason to stop leaking high-value leads. We can start with our diagnostic audit at zero upfront commitment.
Objection_Playbook.AUTHORITY: Got it. Who on your management team handles operational technology and intake software so I can include them?
Objection_Playbook.SECURITY: All our pipelines are SOC-2 and HIPAA compliant with end-to-end encryption. Your client data never trains public models.
Objection_Playbook.INTEGRATION: We connect directly via webhooks to your existing CRM and calendar (ServiceTitan, Clio, Dentrix, Procore, HubSpot) with zero migration hassle.
Objection_Playbook.STAFF: This doesn't replace your staff — it empowers them by handling repetitive triage and 2 AM emergencies so they arrive to work with organized, booked appointments.

quarantined_leads.Call_Script:

6. PRICE EXPECTATION: Ballpark figure, what kind of number would you need to see to make selling today make complete sense for you?

7. NEXT STEP: Let's do this: I'll run our comps and prepare a formal written cash offer for you by this afternoon. What's the best email address to send that over to?

8. POLITE EXIT (If Not Interested): Understood LSREF7, I completely respect that. If anything changes down the road, feel free to keep my number. Have a great day!

1. CONTEXT: Confirming I have the right person - are you still the owner of James Wilson?

2. OPEN TO SELLING: We buy properties strictly as-is for cash, meaning you don't pay any agent fees, make any repairs, or pay closing costs. If we could agree on a fair price, would you consider selling?

3. MOTIVATION: What would be the main goal for you if you did decide to part with it? Are you looking to reinvest, cash out, or just avoid future headaches?

4. TIMELINE: In an ideal world, how quickly would you want to close? We can close in 7 days or give you up to 60 days if you need time.

5. PROPERTY CONDITION: How would you describe the overall condition? Any major updates to the roof, HVAC, or plumbing needed, or is it move-in ready?

6. PRICE EXPECTATION: Ballpark figure, what kind of number would you need to see to make selling today make complete sense for you?

7. NEXT STEP: Let's do this: I'll run our comps and prepare a formal written cash offer for you by this afternoon. What's the best email address to send that over to?

8. POLITE EXIT (If Not Interested): Understood Johnson, I completely respect that. If anything changes down the road, feel free to keep my number. Have a great day!
